text:
release-manager: starting tinywave staged rollout for api-service v2.3.1 — change window 03:00 UTC. plan: 5% -> 10% -> 15% in 5m steps. initial canary pinned: route=canary-v2.3.1. watching latency/errors. @eng-sre @eng-runtime please ack
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout initiated: target=5% for region=eu-west; canary instances spun up (3 pods). health checks: 4/4 passing. logs: /deploy/logs/2759998888
sam: ack. watching p95 and kv-cache rates
anya: ack. starting trace sweep on canary nodes; will look at CPU/IO patterns
deploy-bot: metric update: canary p95=185ms, errors=0.12% after 2m
sam: seeing small bump in avg p95 around 03:06 -> 190->230ms for a 30s window, not sure if transient
anya: digging into traces — multiple requests showing KV cache misses + backend shard rebalance events on canary nodes
deploy-bot: warning: p95 > 200ms threshold hit for 2m on canary (eu-west) :warning:
maria: hold the ramp. do NOT move to 10%. pausing rollout at 5%. @ops-bot, mark hold and pin v2.3.1 at 5%
ops-bot: Rollout PAUSED at 5% by maria. Canary traffic pinned. Notifying oncall.
anya: root cause likely background shard rebalance triggered by new instance labels on canary group. proposing quick opt-out on canary nodes to stop rebalance until stable
anya: patch to opt-out (applied to canary nodes):
```
kubectl label nodes canary-1 canary=true
kubectl annotate nodes canary-1 rebalance=disabled
kubectl label nodes canary-2 canary=true
kubectl annotate nodes canary-2 rebalance=disabled
kubectl label nodes canary-3 canary=true
kubectl annotate nodes canary-3 rebalance=disabled
```
anya: applied to 3 canary hosts at 03:12 UTC — observing CPU drop now
deploy-bot: metric update: canary p95=178ms, errors=0.09% after patch :white_check_mark:
sam: looks stable. traces show reduced backend queueing and fewer KV misses
maria: ok, plan: resume to 10% now, then wait 5m and move to 15% if stable. trigger sequence manually. rollback target if unhealthy: v2.3.0
release-manager: resume to 10% (manual ramp), keep pin for eu-west only. others remain on latest stable
deploy-bot: shifting traffic -> 10% now. health checks running... all checks passing
devops-sre: monitoring dashboards: kvcache hit rate recovered, p95 holding ~170-185ms. will keep guard rails on
anya: quick note: post-deploy followup item to add explicit rebalance gating for future canary node labels (ticket RED-4129)
maria: copied release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/v2.3.1 — includes cache affinity fix, perf tweaks. tagging for changelog
sam: thumbs up. if we see p95 > 220ms or errors > 1% for 5m at any point, abort and rollback to v2.3.0.
maria: agreed. set monitoring alert thresholds and escalation channels. thanks all — holding until 03:25 for final ok. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Rollout status: 10% (eu-west). Next scheduled ramp to 15% at 03:18 UTC unless hold invoked.
release-manager: final check — any outstanding concerns?
anа: (typo check) — all good from SRE side. will escalate if anything new pops up
devops-sre: leaving watches on until 03:30. prepping postmortem template in case we need it
maria: thanks team. resuming watch. will call rollback if thresholds breach.
